notes.title: Get your jetpack ready, take to the skies and remember Sky is just the beginning
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595578/abed4132c877186b8662c586d5e8c1377e62af39.png

Get your jetpack ready, take to the skies and remember: Sky is just the beginning!

If after playing "Star Wars Jedi: Survivor" you were left wanting to feel like a Stormtrooper with Jetpack we bring you back Windfolk: Sky is just the beginning. A third person shooter, but in the sky. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595578/4a661fd23c73cfb24b9a270dbab862f12e0c8e65.png
You will be able to explore every corner of Eurian: from a tropical environment with floating islands to an inhospitable desert with the remains of an ancient civilization. Help Esen protect his planet with different skills, weapons and synergies that you can combine as you wish to fight in your own way. You'll have to shoot down moving targets so hopefully you'll have better aim than the Stormtroopers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42595578/90cd81a4389ea0c5bcd95fe59cb7a367d4c8b923.png
Take to the skies of this planet in two different ways: following the story with the campaign mode or playing in different ways with the arcade and its different game modes. 
The soundtrack that adapts to the combat situations and has a different theme for each level of the game will make flying, exploring and fighting an unforgettable experience for your ears.

Featured content:

 A fast-paced action in which the protagonist can move freely, in all directions of space, even up and down.
 Very refined flight mechanics.  
 Different game modes that invite both to delve into the story and to enjoy only specific mechanics (racing, shooting ...).
 An immersive soundtrack, to make the experience of exploring the skies of Eurian more intense.
 Now available on Playstation Store and Steam.

Get ready to dive into a unique experience with Windfolk: Sky is just the Beginning!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1966700/Windfolk_Sky_is_just_the_Beginning/
